name: @areca-cms/skills
description: Agent skills for Areca CMS: the site SDK and the MCP server. Installs into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and 20+ other agents.

scripts.clean: node --eval "for (const d of ['dist', 'skills']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc && node --eval "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755); fs.cpSync('../../skills', 'skills', { recursive: true })"
